chunks: The eminent jurist Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babuwayh al-Qummi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi from Nasr ibn Muzahim from Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Mas'udi from al-'Ala' ibn Yazid al-Qurashi. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them) said: My father narrated to me from his father from his grandfather (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) said:

The Messenger of Allah said: Sha'ban is my month, and Ramadan is the month of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. Whoever fasts a day in my month, I will be his intercessor on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever fasts two days in my month, his past sins will be forgiven. Whoever fasts three days in my month, it will be said to him: 'Resume your deeds.' And whoever fasts the month of Ramadan, guards his private parts, holds his tongue, and stops harming people, Allah will forgive his past and future sins, free him from the Fire, place him in the Abode of Settlement, and accept his intercession for as many monotheist sinners as there are grains of sand in the desert of 'Alij.

key_terms.رَمْل عَالِج: the sand of 'Alij (a vast Arabian desert)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the rewards of fasting in Sha'ban and Ramadan?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) describes Sha'ban as his personal month and Ramadan as God's month. He outlines progressive rewards for fasting in Sha'ban: one day earns his intercession on Judgment Day, two days brings forgiveness of past sins, and three days grants a fresh start. Fasting the entirety of Ramadan while maintaining moral conduct — guarding one's chastity, speech, and conduct toward others — yields comprehensive forgiveness, liberation from Hellfire, entry into Paradise, and the ability to intercede for countless sinners.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi rh) narrated to us. He said: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi’l Qasim narrated to me from Muhammad b. `Ali al-Kufi from Nasr b. Mazahim from Abi `Abd al-Rahman al-Mas`udi from al-`Alaa’ b. Yazid al-Qurashi. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said: My father narrated to me from his father from his grandfather (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

Sha`ban is my month, and Ramadan is the month of Allah. Whoever fasts a day in my month, I will intercede for him on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever fasts two days in my month, his past sins will be forgiven. Whoever fasts three days in my month, it will be said to him: “Resume your deeds” (i.e. you will start anew). Whoever fasts the month of Ramadan, guards his private, holds his tongue, and stops harming people, Allah will forgive his past and future sins, and He will make him free from the Fire, and He will put him in the Abode of Settlement, and He will accept his intercession for as many monotheist sinners as there are grains of sand.
